scope: Curated design-focused articles, not every post on the domain. Marketing/pricing content excluded.

articles.title: The 7 Principles of Design Explained
articles.application: The seven governing composition principles and seven visual elements; diagnosis starts from emphasis and moves toward unity.

articles.title: Balance in Design
articles.application: Distinguishes symmetry, asymmetry and radial arrangements; visual weight also depends on saturation, detail and empty space.

articles.title: Contrast in Design
articles.application: Six kinds of visual contrast; high contrast as a hierarchy mechanism must be distinguished from WCAG text/component contrast.

articles.title: Emphasis in Design
articles.application: Focal point versus multi-level hierarchy; scale, isolation, position and directional cues work together.

articles.title: Movement in Design
articles.application: Entry point, scan path and meaningful destination; directional cues should not be confused with actual animation.

articles.title: Pattern in Design
articles.application: Repetition arranged as rhythm; patterns can add identity but dense patterns compete with content.

articles.title: Proportion in Design
articles.application: Relative scale, modular ratios and responsive adaptation; golden ratio is a starting heuristic, not a mandate.

articles.title: Unity in Design
articles.application: Cohesion via consistent type, color, spacing, imagery and hierarchy with purposeful variety.

articles.title: Repetition in Design
articles.application: Consistency across components and surfaces creates recognition; too much repetition creates monotony.

articles.title: Visual Hierarchy in Design
articles.application: Scanning order can be tested with blur/squint, limited exposure and grayscale; color alone is insufficient.

articles.title: White Space in Design
articles.application: Active and passive negative space; sparse treatment may be inappropriate for comparison-heavy tasks.

articles.title: Gestalt Principles of Design
articles.application: Proximity, similarity, continuity, closure, figure-ground and common fate provide grouping checks.

articles.title: Design Tokens Explained
articles.application: Primitive, semantic and component levels; encode visual intent for maintainable, responsive UI.

articles.title: Design System vs Style Guide vs Brand Guidelines
articles.application: Distinguishes strategic brand constraints, visual style guidance and coded UI components/tokens.

articles.title: Wireframe vs Mockup vs Prototype
articles.application: Choose fidelity to answer the next question, do not use static mockups as interaction evidence.

articles.title: Color Theory for Brand Design
articles.application: Four hue relationship schemes, restrained accent usage, context-sensitive color association and surface-specific output.

articles.title: Serif vs Sans Serif Fonts
articles.application: Typography families convey tone but choice depends on rendered readability and the brand, not categorical absolutes.

articles.title: Kerning, Leading & Tracking Explained
articles.application: Pair spacing, line spacing and overall character spacing have distinct purposes and tests.

articles.title: Aesthetic Branding Guide
articles.application: Coherent aesthetic spans palette, type, photography, imagery, layout, motion and small graphical details.

articles.title: Mood Board for Design & Branding
articles.application: Define a small, annotated set of visual references anchored to audience and intent before choosing aesthetics.

articles.title: Brand Guidelines Guide
articles.application: Operational visual rules prevent drift: palette, type, imagery, usage constraints and application examples.

articles.title: Vector vs Raster Explained
articles.application: Use scalable vector for icons/logos and appropriate raster sizes/formats for photos; avoid blurry scaling and unlicensed assets.

articles.title: What Is Brand Identity
articles.application: Distinguishes identity, strategy and applied aesthetic; frontend expressions should not invent a new brand.

articles.title: Font Licensing for Resellers
articles.application: Verify web embedding and distribution permissions instead of copying proprietary font binaries or assuming desktop licenses cover the web.
